items.title: Anthropic proposes supervoting shares to give co-founders majority control -report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Anthropic (NASDAQ:ANTP) is seeking shareholder approval for a dual-class share structure that would hand its seven co-founders majority voting control ahead of a highly anticipated initial public offering, according to a report from The Information. Under the proposed terms, Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei and his co-founding team would secure a combined 50.1% voting stake in most corporate matters, mirroring a collective-control framework famously deployed by Palantir Tech
